description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for managing Git notes within the libgit2 library, including note iteration, reading, creating, removing, and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: git_note_iterator_new
methods.description: Creates a new iterator for notes in a repository, optionally specifying the reference. Returns 0 on success or an error code.

methods.name: git_note_iterator_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a git_note_iterator.

methods.name: git_note_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next note, returning 0 if successful, GIT_ITEROVER if iteration is complete, or an error code.

methods.name: git_note_read
methods.description: Reads a note associated with a specific object ID in a repository.

methods.name: git_note_author
methods.description: Retrieves the author signature of a note.

methods.name: git_note_committer
methods.description: Retrieves the committer signature of a note.

methods.name: git_note_message
methods.description: Gets the message content of a note.

methods.name: git_note_id
methods.description: Returns the object ID of the note.

methods.name: git_note_create
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a note for a specified object ID in a repository.

methods.name: git_note_remove
methods.description: Removes a note from a specified object ID in a repository.

methods.name: git_note_default_ref
methods.description: Retrieves the default reference name for notes in a repository.

methods.name: git_note_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all notes in a specified namespace, invoking a callback for each.
